name: agentic-app-documentation-page
context: Design a documentation or wiki page interface for an AI-powered application. The audience is developers and users reading technical docs, API references, and guides generated or curated by AI agents. Target platforms: desktop and tablet. Must support sidebar navigation, search, code examples, and versioning.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for heading hierarchy, prose, and code snippets
Apply color.rules.json for syntax highlighting tokens and callout box variants
Use layout.rules.json for sidebar + content + table-of-contents three-panel layout
Code blocks must use monospace font token with accessible contrast
All navigation landmarks must have unique aria-labels
Search must support keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K or Ctrl+K) with focus management

outputCriteria.format: Page layout spec with navigation tree, content area, and TOC panel
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens
Code blocks use monospace font with proper background contrast
Callout components (info, warning, error) use feedback color tokens
accessibilityRequirements: Navigation tree uses treeview role with proper aria-expanded
Code blocks have accessible labels or descriptions
Table of contents links use same-page navigation
Search dialog traps focus and returns on close

examples.output:
Molecule: NavTreeItem
  role: treeitem
  aria-expanded: true|false
  Layout: flex(direction: column)
  Children:
    - Molecule: NavLink
        Layout: flex(direction: row, gap: var(--space-xs), align: center)
        padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
        radius: var(--radius-sm)
        Content:
          - Atom: Icon(name=chevron-down, size=16, rotate=collapsed?-90:0)
          - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.primary)
        States: default, hover(bg: var(--color-surface-hover)), active(bg: var(--color-surface-selected), font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium))
    - Organism: NavTreeChildren(role=group, padding-left: var(--space-md))
acceptanceCriteria: Nested items indented with consistent spacing
